facts.text: We ride at dawn. Tonight the Regulators eat, so pass the beans.
facts.why: Invented. A real Billy line from the ranch dinner scene on the opened quote page is 'He was hacking on me.'

vibe.verdict: The Tunstall ranch and Regulators are right, but the menu is a plain western and the 'Mess hall mains' heading sits alone with the dishes in the other column.
missing: The peyote trip with Chavez (the desert)
Billy and the Regulators killing Sheriff Brady
The outhouse shootout with Buckshot Roberts
The burning McSween house and Billy in the trunk
ideas: Move 'MESS HALL MAINS' heading to sit above the two mains in the right column
Swap 'Venison sausage' note ('Tunstall's rule') for a 'Dirty crockery duty' joke
Replace 'Hard apple cider' note with a Doc Scurlock poem line
Swap 'Biscochitos' for 'Pals' epitaph cookies stamped with PALS
